prompt: A glass of water is left in a freezer overnight. The water freezes. Did the temperature of the water drop or stay the same while it was freezing? Explain in one sentence.
gold: Temperature stays at 0 C (freezing point) while the phase change happens; it drops after all ice forms.

weakest-single.text: The temperature of the water dropped while it was freezing.

best-single.text: The temperature of the water dropped as it froze overnight in the freezer.

draft-raw.text: The temperature of the water dropped from the ambient temperature of the freezer (usually around 0°C) to 0°C, as it froze.

swarm-free.text: The temperature of the water dropped from the ambient temperature of the freezer to 0°C while it was freezing.

swarm-fuse.text: The temperature of the water dropped from the ambient temperature of the freezer to 0°C while it was freezing.
